description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Email, which extends from Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop. It provides functionality for detecting email client user agents, specifically Thunderbird, by matching user agent strings and returning the type as 'email'.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Email
classes.description: A class for detecting email client user agents, extending Desktop user agent detection.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the user agent matches email signatures like Thunderbird.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the user agent, in this case 'email'.
